who: Developers building AI agents need a controlled environment to execute agent-requested commands without exposing their host machines to unsafe operations.
agent_work: SafeAgent accepts a command request, validates it against a safety policy, records the allow or block decision in an audit log, and routes approved commands to a Celesto sandbox. The API records execution outcomes and cleanup status.
proof_output: The local API returned HTTP 400 for the destructive command rm -rf / and wrote a block decision to logs/commands.jsonl. An allowed command was also audited, but its Celesto execution failed with CloudAPIError.
